searchText: I noticed `Nimbus EL` is reporting with the same client code we had expected nimbus CL to report with in graffiti watermarking, which is kind of a collision given the order in watermarks wasn't guaranteed... We probably need to make them unique if we want the EL/CL order on watermarks to be not important, as atm in devnet6 it kind of looks like 2 CL's in the watermark `lighthouse-nimbusel-1 NB94LH0d`

excerpts.content:
I noticed `Nimbus EL` is reporting with the same client code we had expected nimbus CL to report with in graffiti watermarking, which is kind of a collision given the order in watermarks wasn't guaranteed...
We probably need to make them unique if we want the EL/CL order on watermarks to be not important, as atm in devnet6 it kind of looks like 2 CL's in the watermark `lighthouse-nimbusel-1 NB94LH0d`
